dialogues.speaker: Qianyun
dialogues.text: This year's tea leaves are yellowed. I hope it won't affect the taste...

dialogues.speaker: Qianyun
dialogues.text: Hello, I'm Qianyun, and I'm in charge of purchasing tea leaves for Yanshang Teahouse.

dialogues.speaker: Qianyun
dialogues.text: Tea has four charms — color, infused leaves, aroma, and texture. Everyone has their preferences.

dialogues.speaker: Qianyun
dialogues.text: If it's them you're looking to purchase, then consider trying at Boss Yip's place.

dialogues.speaker: Qianyun
dialogues.text: His teas have a strong aroma and taste that have captured the hearts of countless enthusiasts. Superb choices indeed.

dialogues.speaker: Qianyun
dialogues.text: I hope to see you next time!

dialogues.speaker: Qianyun
dialogues.text: The teahouse has really brightened up after the boss took over and kicked the Fatui and gamblers out.

dialogues.speaker: Qianyun
dialogues.text: Now, Yanshang Teahouse is worthy of the title "best teahouse in Liyue Harbor."

dialogues.speaker: Qianyun
dialogues.text: If you're looking for a place to rest there, do pay us a visit!
